_note: 本文件是 `validate_audit_state.py --self-test` 的轻量 fixture 自测清单：记录每个 invalid-* 目录必须出现的预期错误片段（message 子串）与精确错误条数（error_count）。valid-* 无需登记。本 skill 的 validator 只校验不变量（身份与引用、前提字段、契约字段、快照绑定、证据图、反证、结论强度、Finding-Gate 绑定、Gate 推导、批次新鲜度、覆盖闭合、探索轮次、授权绑定），不做字段级表单校验——id 格式、路径词法、目录布局、未建模键一类仍以 valid-* fixture 为准。三处例外属于不变量检查而非表单检查，因为它们失效的后果是「检查被静默跳过」而不是「字段不好看」：(1)「身份与引用」——重复 id 会静默覆盖、悬空引用会静默解析为空，两者都让不变量退化成空操作；(2)「不变量前提字段」——驱动不变量判定的字段若缺失，本该静默跳过检查，pass 0 将其改为报错；(3)「驱动枚举」——驱动值是与字面量比较的开关（`phase == "FINAL"`、`severity in {"Critical","High"}`、`disconfirmationResult == "counter-supported"`），差一个字符不会得到错误结论，而是根本得不到结论：判据落空，受它保护的不变量对该对象静默停跑。差一个字符因此比一个明显错误的值更危险——后者至少还有别的检查会报出来。error_count 为精确匹配：它防止新增检查时把已有 case 的报错面悄悄放大（例如给一个本应只报一条的 case 追加无关错误）。
invalid-binding-missing-snapshot-key: must declare an explicit snapshot key
invalid-disposition-combination: explicit disposition is allowed only for CONFIRMED findings
invalid-empty-gate-coverage: declared READY, but state derives INCOMPLETE
invalid-evidence-strength-unrepeatable: a single observation cannot carry that strength
invalid-final-gap-without-gate: cannot close with a High challenge GAP
invalid-final-without-required-claim: requires at least one REQUIRED Claim
invalid-gap-challenge-carries-completed-: must be omitted when status is GAP
must record why the challenge could not be completed
invalid-gate-applies-without-evidence: APPLIES requires supporting or contextual current-applicability Evidence
invalid-obligation-case: requires at least one REQUIRED Claim
invalid-rated-finding-without-risk: required to judge a CONFIRMED Finding
cannot be skipped by omitting risk
invalid-ready-with-insufficient-evidence: declared READY, but state derives INCOMPLETE
invalid-severity-deviation-without-ratio: deviates from impact Medium and requires a rationale
invalid-test-discrimination-without-yes: requires at least one Evidence with testDiscrimination.result=YES
invalid-verified-unit-without-evidence: a verified Unit requires at least one DIRECT Evidence
